{{Top|leg|canon=Avedamé}}
'''Avedame''' was a type of [[Alcohol/Legends|wine]] made from a [[Color/Legends|red-purple]] [[Avedame fruit|fruit]]. The fruit was produced by a [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]]-like [[Tree/Legends|tree]] in the [[Jasserak Highlands]] of [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
